name: Claude Slides (deck artifact type)
what: Presentation decks at 16:9 or 4:3 that people present, edit in place and download as PowerPoint, PDF or PNG. Slides are HTML sections styled by one shared stylesheet, with CSS motion and no script. A deck installs brand tokens and fonts from a Design System artifact.
install: No install line. Artifacts and the Slides template must be on for the claude.ai account; on Team and Enterprise an organization Owner enables them in organization settings. In Claude Code, sign in with /login and a claude.ai account.
firstCall: Artifact quickstart with intent 'slides' when the host offers it, else an Artifact types list, to get the type link; then read the type's SKILL.md that the create call returns
evidenceNote: Artifact read calls on the type's SKILL.md, craft, layout, styles, fonts, images and diagrams files succeeded. Public Help Center pages and the Claude Code command reference were read. NOT exercised: creating a deck, writing a slide, any download, PPTX fidelity, Send to, any partner import tool. No per-call credits; work draws from the shared plan usage pool. The fallback is a Design canvas with one fixed artboard for each slide; it helps only when artifacts are present.
